content: Character embeddings are obtained from a Bi-LSTM which takes as input a sequence of characters of each token, similarly to BIBREF0 . An alternative approach for obtaining character embeddings is using a convolutional neural network as in BIBREF1 , but we find that Bi-LSTM representation of characters yields empirically better results in our experiments.
